pages.title: Cherenkov Bricks
pages.text: Cherenkov quartz cut into small bricks, each one glowing softly blue along its edges. A wall of them looks like a shallow pool at night. They are smooth and slightly cool to the touch. Every joint carries its own thin line of blue light, so the whole wall seems sketched in glow.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I cut Cherenkov quartz into bricks to make glowing walls with more texture than plain blocks. The light catches along every seam.
$(thing)Used in$(): Cherenkov Bricks Slab, Cherenkov Bricks Stairs, Cherenkov Bricks Wall.
